scope: Independent survival world; normal production mayfly grant, logical double-space entry and W motion. F5 uses vanilla KeyMapping.click/consumeClick. glStageScope: AFTER_PARTICLES brackets multiple subscribers and asserts blend/cache/framebuffer/color state only. Sword renderer legitimately binds WHITE/depth false even with no swords; texture/depth/program across that entire event are observations. Two separate exact MeteorBloomRenderer.State boundary checks use active unit2 sentinel plus actual shader apply, normal close and injected exception finally, and compare all saved GL/cache/program/texture/clearColor state. GUI/no-GUI screenshots cover real deferred composites; sample ticks distinguish stale GUI-pre observations.
